actual: P1 avoidable CI reruns: run --mode pr pushes a new branch HEAD before reusing an existing PR, and existing PR create recovery returns URL without synchronizing its generated body. GitHub synchronize event captures stale commit-bound receipts. Update only the owned source PR from validated finish evidence before push, reuse exact matching PR, keep remote/local HEAD guards and required CI for every new HEAD.
